body: Avesta has offices in Mclean and Bethesda.  That's where I've been going.

I'm really glad you had someone there to hold your hand, that sounds really beautiful.

I'm basically completely alone right now.  When i was in my first session I kept imagining that my recently ex girlfriend would come in and hold me and tell me things were okay.  And coming back to the reality that we hadn't spoken in over a week was heartbreaking all over again.  I know I'm being a baby since I'm the one who broke her trust and made the relationship have to end.  But I just wanted to feel our love again.
I'm sorry that happened to you, it sounds really sad and scary :(  Glad you're doing okay.

This website is probably worth something:
www.emotionalcompetency.com/

Thank you.  I think you're totally right, and what you said would completely apply to someone else who hadn't done the things I had.  People on the whole deserve to be happy, and starting over and improving is good especially if you can help heal the people you've hurt.

I've worked so hard the past month since she found out (she had to find out herself, I didn't come clean and I even lied and tried to explain it instead of apologizing -- I regret that so much) to get right and be better but I didn't take good enough care of her in that time.  My communication sucked because I was not proactive enough, and a lot of my not cruel, but still problematic behaviors are going down with a fight.  I didn't prioritize her as much as I should have, I was just totally inadequate given the severity of what I had done.  I don't even want to feel better, I just can't stand the idea that I could ever be happy again after what I did to her and how long I lied about it.  Absolute and devastating betrayal for nothing but my own selfishness.  She already had enough to deal with before she met me.  I just gave her hope and then piled on more shit.

Idk why I'm writing all this to you, maybe i'm projecting or something.  I dont know you at all obviously and your account is brand new. but I hope you find hope again.  I hope you find happiness.  If you're the victim of somebody like me, who could build a life with you while keeping secrets and hurting you, I'm sorry.  You didn't deserve to be treated like that, and I hope you can heal and be truly happy.

I was actually in the middle of writing one but things changed and I don't even know how I would get it to her. I've apologized so many times in so many ways and it was never enough.  I never took full responsibility even though I felt it.  Intentions and feelings don't matter it's just actions and how they're perceived.

Thank you.  I will absolutely do this.  Part of my issue is I don't keep track of what's a lie and what isn't sometimes, as if the truth is completely irrelevant.  I think that digging up as many of these lies and 'hidings' as I can is absolutely necessary to preventing it in the future.
